en.headline: deTour 2026 design festival continues at PMQ until 29 November
en.dek: PMQ said the free annual design festival, themed Better Not Perfect: Prototypes for Tomorrow, features 14 works across three zones and a new pop-up shop.
body: The deTour 2026 design festival continues at PMQ in Central until 29 November, organised by PMQ and sponsored by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency.

The event, themed Better Not Perfect: Prototypes for Tomorrow, presents 14 works by local, mainland and international creators across three zones exploring concepts, materials and future-oriented design. A pop-up shop has been introduced for the first time, offering limited-edition items and merchandise.
Admission is free. Opening hours are 11am to 8pm daily, except on 20 November when it closed at 3pm. Workshops, dialogues and guided tours are also available.

zh.headline: deTour 2026設計節於元創方持續至11月29日
zh.dek: 元創方表示，免費年度設計節以「不完美，更美好」為主題，設三大展區展出14件作品，並首設快閃選物店。
body: deTour 2026設計節於中環元創方持續舉行至11月29日，由元創方主辦、文創產業發展處資助。
今屆以「BETTER, NOT PERFECT：Prototypes for Tomorrow」為題，匯聚本地、內地及海外創作者的14件作品，分三大展區呈現概念、物料及未來設計。場內首設快閃選物店，出售限量產品及周邊。
入場免費。開放時間為每日上午11時至晚上8時，20日則至下午3時。另設工作坊、對話及導賞團。
